## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and

with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

technologies and providing innovative solutions in surgical, neurologic and regenerative care. At
Integra, we work with one central goal: to create healthier people, a healthier workplace and a
healthier world.

dural access and repair, cerebral spinal fluid management and neuro-critical care.

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.
[ Oncology ][167]
[ Immunology ][168]
[ Neuroscience ][169]
[ Cardiopulmonary ][170]
[ Learn more ][171]
[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.
[ Cardiovascular ][173]
[ Orthopaedics ][174]
[ Surgery ][175]
[ Vision ][176]

### [What is wAIHA?][211]

Warm autoimmune hemolytic anemia (wAIHA) causes fatigue so profound, it can limit the lives of
people who have the condition. Learn more about this rare disease and a potential targeted treatment
developed by Johnson & Johnson that’s currently in clinical trials.

# We’re tackling the world’s toughest health challenges

[ Medicines & therapies ][166]
Johnson & Johnson Innovative Medicine is leading where medicine is going. Patients inform and
inspire our science-based innovations, which continue to change and save lives. With rigorous
science and compassion, we confidently address the most complex diseases of our time and unlock the
medicines of tomorrow. Healthcare areas include: Oncology, Immunology, Neuroscience and
Cardiopulmonary.

[ Medical devices & technology ][172]
Johnson & Johnson MedTech innovates at the intersection of biology and technology. With a focus on
treating with pinpoint precision in the hardest-to-reach parts of the body, restoring anatomy and
reimagining healing, our portfolio of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments is
addressing the most complex health challenges. Healthcare areas include: Cardiovascular,
Orthopaedics, Surgery and Vision.

Engineering the 

extraordinary

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]
[------------------]

Careers

 

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention

## Smith+Nephew's top products

[ALLEVYN-LIFE-HERO-1-840x840-PX.png]

#### ALLEVYN^{◊} LIFE Foam Dressings

In a climate of growing expectations and budget restrictions,^{1-3} ALLEVYN LIFE Dressings may help
improve efficiency and patient satisfaction in community wound care,^{*4-7 }and have been shown to
support pressure injury prevention protocols^{8,9}
[ View product ][80]
[REGENETEN implant on RCR image from animation]

#### REGENETEN^{◊} Bioinductive Implant

Bioinductive collagen scaffold for tendon repair.^{1-3} Resorbed and replaced by new tendon-like
tissue within 6 months to support tendon healing.1,2,4-8
[ View product ][81]
[Hero 1 CORI Surgical System.png]

#### CORI^{◊} Surgical System

Combine your skill with handheld robotics and digital surgery applications across a range of joint
arthroplasty indications. Experience the power of one platform.
[ View product ][82]
[Tula Tympanostomy Kit]

#### Tula^{®} Tympanostomy System

An in-office alternative to traditional tympanostomy using a revolutionary, local anesthesia system
and an automated, 1-click tube delivery device.^{1,2}
[ View product ][83]
[Close up of EDGE, front]

#### RENASYS^{◊} EDGE Negative Pressure Wound Therapy System

The latest evolution in powerful RENASYS tNPWT features an improved user interface for enhanced
intuitiveness and simplicity, with a durable pump built to offer maintenance-free use^{*1-3}
[ View product ][84]
[41813 CARTIHEAL Product Page Hero Image V2]

#### CARTIHEAL^{◊} AGILI-C^{◊} Cartilage Repair Implant

A single-stage, off-the-shelf solution for knee cartilage and osteochondral defects, with or without
mild to moderate osteoarthritis (KL 0-3) comprised of a proprietary biomaterial that is porous and
biocompatible.
[ View product ][85]
[JOURNEYII_BCS_ROX_RoundPatella_AngledView_onWhite.png]

#### JOURNEY II^{◊} ROX^{◊} Total Knee Solution with CONCELOC^{◊} and OXINIUM^{◊} Technologies

Combining cemented and cementless technologies for a reverse hybrid approach, we bring to the stage
our latest and greatest in joint reconstruction
[ View product ][86]
[COR22-33747-V1-ProjectsAlchemy-AirwayMgmt-Hero-1122.png]

#### COBLATION^{◊} Technology for Airway Management

Designed for precise tissue removal^{1-5 }with a low thermal profile⁶
[ View product ][87]

## Transforming lives

Learn how our history and our passion drive us to strengthen, accelerate and transform the future of
medical technology

## Wound Care

Smith+Nephew's Wound Care (Advanced Wound Management) portfolio provides comprehensive solutions to
meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

[GettyImages-1448442087-CUT-OUT-SHAPE.png]

### Wound care indications

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

[ View all ][88]

### Wound care products

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

## Sports Medicine

From elite athletes to weekend warriors, everyone wants to get back to doing what they love after a
sporting injury. With our leading-edge technology, we help patients get back to living a Life
Unlimited.

[ Explore sports medicine ][90]
[Homepage Sports Medicine business unit teaser]

## Orthopaedic Reconstruction

Smith+Nephew's Orthopaedics portfolio includes an innovative range of hip and knee implants used to
replace diseased, damaged or worn joints, robotics-assisted and enabling technologies, and services
that empower surgeons. It also includes trauma products used to stabilise severe fractures and
correct bone deformities.

*Remy*,
living with PK deficiency,
and her mom, Becky

# Fueled by Connections
# 
# to Transform Rare Diseases^{™}

We are
*Agios*

We are committed to continually raising the bar for ourselves and our science. But we don’t do it
alone.

The relationships we cultivate across and outside of our organization deepen our impact as leaders
in the field of cellular metabolism and propel our ability to bring new therapies to market.

[ View our corporate video ][37]

Our ability to work together with patient communities, healthcare professionals, partners and
colleagues – and honor each of their perspectives – powers our continued success in creating
groundbreaking therapies for the patients who need them.

The intersection of our experiences and expertise catalyzes ideas and unearths insights. It sparks
creativity. It creates efficiency. It drives scientific discoveries that result in pioneering
therapies.

What *patients *are
saying about us

*Golie,*

living with sickle cell disease

> Working with Agios has been a breath of fresh air! It is clear that the Agios team’s primary
> objective is to provide treatments that will address the needs of the patients they represent.

*Patients*
at the center

We’re here to make a difference in the lives of people with rare diseases.

At Agios, we put patient needs, concerns, input and collaboration at the center of our work. That’s
how we help to ensure that the therapies we’re developing and the complementary support programs
we’re providing address their needs and deliver the biggest impact possible.

[ Learn More ][38]

*Laurice,*

living with thalassemia

> *Patient engagement* isn’t just a box-ticking exercise at Agios. They form sincere connections
> with patients and advocates, to be sure our perspective and experience are front and center from
> the start.

Our pioneering leadership in cellular metabolism

Since our founding, Agios has been a pioneering leader in cellular metabolism, advancing therapies
for patients with unmet needs. Our mature and unique understanding of the science is foundational to
our success and the connective thread that binds our people and our pipeline together.

[ Our Science ][39]

Our therapeutic areas of focus

We are developing therapies for people with rare diseases, with a near-term focus on hemolytic and
acquired anemias. Our goal is to establish a strong portfolio of therapeutic candidates that have
the potential to provide disease-modifying and long-term rather than merely palliative effects for
patients with unmet needs.

[ Our Areas of Focus ][40]

What’s new

at *Agios*

Inside *Agios*

At Agios, our culture is central to our success. And central to our culture is our commitment to
maintaining a supportive and flexible work environment — where every person is encouraged to bring
their whole selves to the office (physically or virtually).

We believe that when people feel seen and respected, they’re able to do their best work. Each of us
bringing our best enables Agios to push the boundaries of science and make the biggest impact
possible in the lives of people with rare diseases.

[ Our Culture ][41]

*Join our team*

Do you want to be part of a team that knows how to turn great science into medicines that *change
lives*? Explore our open positions!

# Fueled by Connections
# 
# to Transform Rare Diseases^{™}

We are
*Agios*

We are committed to continually raising the bar for ourselves and our science. But we don’t do it
alone.

The relationships we cultivate across and outside of our organization deepen our impact as leaders
in the field of cellular metabolism and propel our ability to bring new therapies to market.

[ View our corporate video ][37]

Our ability to work together with patient communities, healthcare professionals, partners and
colleagues – and honor each of their perspectives – powers our continued success in creating
groundbreaking therapies for the patients who need them.

The intersection of our experiences and expertise catalyzes ideas and unearths insights. It sparks
creativity. It creates efficiency. It drives scientific discoveries that result in pioneering
therapies.

What *patients *are
saying about us

*Golie,*

living with sickle cell disease

> Working with Agios has been a breath of fresh air! It is clear that the Agios team’s primary
> objective is to provide treatments that will address the needs of the patients they represent.

*Patients*
at the center

We’re here to make a difference in the lives of people with rare diseases.

At Agios, we put patient needs, concerns, input and collaboration at the center of our work. That’s
how we help to ensure that the therapies we’re developing and the complementary support programs
we’re providing address their needs and deliver the biggest impact possible.

[ Learn More ][38]

*Laurice,*

living with thalassemia

> *Patient engagement* isn’t just a box-ticking exercise at Agios. They form sincere connections
> with patients and advocates, to be sure our perspective and experience are front and center from
> the start.

Our pioneering leadership in cellular metabolism

Since our founding, Agios has been a pioneering leader in cellular metabolism, advancing therapies
for patients with unmet needs. Our mature and unique understanding of the science is foundational to
our success and the connective thread that binds our people and our pipeline together.

[ Our Science ][39]

Our therapeutic areas of focus

We are developing therapies for people with rare diseases, with a near-term focus on hemolytic and
acquired anemias. Our goal is to establish a strong portfolio of therapeutic candidates that have
the potential to provide disease-modifying and long-term rather than merely palliative effects for
patients with unmet needs.

[ Our Areas of Focus ][40]

What’s new

at *Agios*

Inside *Agios*

At Agios, our culture is central to our success. And central to our culture is our commitment to
maintaining a supportive and flexible work environment — where every person is encouraged to bring
their whole selves to the office (physically or virtually).

We believe that when people feel seen and respected, they’re able to do their best work. Each of us
bringing our best enables Agios to push the boundaries of science and make the biggest impact
possible in the lives of people with rare diseases.

[ Our Culture ][41]

Do you want to be part of a team that knows how to turn great science into medicines that *change

## Create a **new world** in **neurosurgery** with us

At Black Forest Medical, we envision a future where cranial stabilization is safer, more reliable,
and more innovative than ever. We ensure that a patient’s head can be positioned safely and
effectively during neurosurgical procedures, empowering healthcare professionals to achieve optimal
patient outcomes.


 

[Visit Us (360° Tour)][28]

# **Patient Safety**

Our commitment to patient safety and our dedication to empowering neurosurgeons with reliable
solutions drive our continued research in cranial stabilization. Discover our evidence-based
workflow recommendations intended to enhance procedural safety. Stay connected to follow our ongoing
research and emerging insights.
 

[Explore here][29]

# **DORO LUCENT**

The DORO LUCENT® Skull Clamp is the ideal choice for all neurosurgical procedures involving
intraoperative CT, X-Ray based Angiography or X-Ray imaging. It is designed to support superior
imaging results and precise control. Its unique and patented release mechanism, along with all
controls, can be accessed without the need to change hand positions, enabling neurosurgeons to fully
operate the clamp themselves. Additionally, interchangeable pin holders support the correct pin
configuration for every patient and head size.

[Learn more][30]

* From newborns to seniors, from non-invasive to invasive applications, from a wide range of
  standard OR tables to carbon-fiber tabletops to spinal frames, from standard to imaging
  environments – there is always a matching DORO® solution.
* DORO® systems exist for each patient positioning need.
* DORO® systems can be mixed and matched with each other thanks to their common interfaces.
* DORO® systems give users the possibility to adjust the system to each user and patient
  individually.
* DORO® systems are designed with a great simplicity and similarity to each other, allowing an
  intuitive handling of all systems.

 

##### **More than 30 Years of Expertise - Proven Solutions**

We specialize in optimal cranial stabilization and brain retraction for more than two decades and
are constantly driven to develop solutions that fit the latest technologies used in surgical

methods guaranteeing a high level of stability during neurosurgical interventions as well as greater
safety for patients.

At Black Forest Medical, we envision a future where cranial stabilization is safer, more reliable,
and more innovative than ever. We ensure that a patient’s head can be positioned safely and
effectively during neurosurgical procedures, empowering healthcare professionals to achieve optimal
patient outcomes.

# **Patient Safety**

solutions drive our continued research in cranial stabilization. Discover our evidence-based
workflow recommendations intended to enhance procedural safety. Stay connected to follow our ongoing
research and emerging insights.

# **DORO LUCENT**

The DORO LUCENT® Skull Clamp is the ideal choice for all neurosurgical procedures involving
intraoperative CT, X-Ray based Angiography or X-Ray imaging. It is designed to support superior

controls, can be accessed without the need to change hand positions, enabling neurosurgeons to fully
operate the clamp themselves. Additionally, interchangeable pin holders support the correct pin
configuration for every patient and head size.

[Learn more][30]

  standard OR tables to carbon-fiber tabletops to spinal frames, from standard to imaging
  environments – there is always a matching DORO® solution.
* DORO® systems exist for each patient positioning need.
* DORO® systems can be mixed and matched with each other thanks to their common interfaces.
* DORO® systems give users the possibility to adjust the system to each user and patient
  individually.
* DORO® systems are designed with a great simplicity and similarity to each other, allowing an
  intuitive handling of all systems.

methods guaranteeing a high level of stability during neurosurgical interventions as well as greater

Our priorities at Conroy are always aiming towards exceeding our customers’ expectations in our
products performance as well as concerning their usability.

Our range of Qseal products are a result of this, which is why we strive to provide a wide range of
tube sealers to cover every need for the staff at blood banks, plasma centers or transfusion
laboratories.

## Blood Bag Tube Sealers With a Wide Range of Functions

In our range of Qseal blood bag tube sealers we offer you for example:
* [**Qseal-free**][35] – a battery-operated cordless blood bag tube sealer for both EVA and PVC
  tubing. The construction is light-weighted and ergonomic, which makes it ideal for usage in mobile
  donation sites.
* [**Qseal-multi**][36] – a benchtop blood bag tube sealer ideal for both single – and multi-use.
  You can connect up to 8 units in multi-setup and operate as segment sealers, with simultaneous
  sealing.
* [**Qseal-opti**][37] – a shockproof and robust benchtop blood bag tube sealer – ideal for heavy
  duty use. Produces both single- and multi-seals.

* Hastanemiz ile kolay iletişim kurabilir,
* Hastanemiz ve Doktorlarımız hakkında detaylı bilgilere ulaşabilir,

**Kullanıcılar menüsünden aile üyelerinizi de ekleyerek,** mobil uygulamamız üzerinden takiplerinizi

[Robotik Cerrahi]

**Robotik Cerrahi’de amaç; hastaya özgü, yumuşak dokularına saygılı, stabil, en doğru şekilde
konumlandırılmış protez yerleştirmektir.**

Robotik Diz ve Kalça Artroplastisi’nin Klasik Yönteme Göre Farkı Nedir?
* Hastaya özel planlama ve uygun protez seçimi yapılır.
* Ameliyat öncesi detaylı cerrahi plan hazırlanır.
* Kemik kesileri hassas ve hatasız gerçekleştirilebilir.
* Yumuşak dokular korunarak protez yerleştirilir.
* Daha az ağrı ve doku hasarıyla iyileşme süreci kolaylaşabilir.
* Erken rehabilitasyon mümkün olabilir.
* Protez ömrü uzayabilir, çıkık riski ve açısal hatalar azalabilir.
* Revizyon ihtimali düşebilir.
* Ameliyat sonrası doğal eklem hissi sağlanabilir.

[Vidasız Dar Kanal]

**Vidasız dar kanal ameliyatı, omurga kanalında meydana gelen daralma nedeniyle sinirlerin sıkışması
ve buna bağlı oluşan ağrı, uyuşma, güç kaybı gibi şikayetlerin giderilmesi için uygulanan bir
cerrahi yöntemdir. **Bu ameliyat, özellikle omurga kanalı daralmasının ileri aşamalarında, sinir
dokularının baskıdan kurtarılması için yapılır ve omurganın stabilitesini artırıcı vida sistemleri
kullanılmadan gerçekleştirilir. Genellikle minimal invaziv tekniklerle uygulanır ve hastanın
iyileşme süresini kısaltmayı hedefler.

### Vidasız Dar Kanal Ameliyatı Neden Tercih Edilir?

Bu ameliyat, özellikle omurganın stabilitesinin tamamen korunabildiği ve vida gibi sabitleyici
materyallere gerek duyulmadığı durumlarda tercih edilir. Bunun birkaç sebebi vardır:
* Omurganın Doğal Yapısının Korunması: Vida ve plaklar kullanılmadığı için omurganın doğal hareket
  kabiliyeti korunur.
* Minimal İnvaziv Teknikler: Daha küçük kesilerle yapılan bu ameliyatlarda kan kaybı, enfeksiyon
  riski ve iyileşme süresi azalır.
* Hasta Konforu: Vida gibi yabancı cisimlerin kullanılmaması hastanın ameliyat sonrası sürecini daha
  konforlu hale getirir.

[MR]

**Çorlu Vatan Hastanesi’nde Yapay Zeka Destekli Yeni MR Cihazımız ile Hizmetinizdeyiz! Daha net
görüntüler ile tanıda ileri teknoloji artık sizin hastanenizde.**
* Multiparametrik Prostat MR
* Temporomandibular Eklem MR
* Tüm Vücut MR
* Kardiak MR

**Tüm Vücut MR**, tek seansta tüm organ ve sistemleri görüntüleyebilen, erken tanıda büyük avantaj
sağlayan en gelişmiş tarama yöntemlerinden biridir. Beyin ve sinir sistemi, boyun, tiroid, akciğer,
karaciğer, safra yolları, pankreas, böbrek, dalak, mide ve bağırsaklar, kadınlarda rahim ve
yumurtalıklar, erkeklerde prostat ve mesane, omurga ve eklemler, kemik iliği ile lenf nodları
incelenir. Radyasyonsuz ve ağrısız olan bu yöntem, hem sağlıklı bireylerde check-up amaçlı hem de
hastalıkların erken evrede yakalanmasında kritik rol oynar.

tedaviyi kolaylaştırıyoruz.
][95]
Mobil Uygulama Robotik Cerrahi Vidasız Dar Kanal MR
[Mobil Uygulama]

**Sağlık hizmetlerimizi cebinize taşıyoruz! **

Sürekli geliştirdiğimiz mobil uygulamamızda;
* Randevu alabilir ve takip edebilir,
* Radyoloji ve Laboratuvar sonuçlarınızı görüntüleyebilir,
* Reçetelerinizi görüntüleyebilir,
* Nöbetçi eczane bilgilerine ulaşabilir,
* Hastanemiz ile kolay iletişim kurabilir,
* Hastanemiz ve Doktorlarımız hakkında detaylı bilgilere ulaşabilir,

**Kullanıcılar menüsünden aile üyelerinizi de ekleyerek,** mobil uygulamamız üzerinden takiplerinizi
gerçekleştirebilirsiniz. 

Çorlu Vatan Hastanesi mobil uygulamamız App Store ve Google Play’de yayında!

Mobil uygulamamızı indirmek için **[tıklayınız][96]**.

[Robotik Cerrahi]

**Robotik Cerrahi’de amaç; hastaya özgü, yumuşak dokularına saygılı, stabil, en doğru şekilde
konumlandırılmış protez yerleştirmektir.**

Robotik Diz ve Kalça Artroplastisi’nin Klasik Yönteme Göre Farkı Nedir?
* Hastaya özel planlama ve uygun protez seçimi yapılır.
* Ameliyat öncesi detaylı cerrahi plan hazırlanır.
* Kemik kesileri hassas ve hatasız gerçekleştirilebilir.
* Yumuşak dokular korunarak protez yerleştirilir.
* Daha az ağrı ve doku hasarıyla iyileşme süreci kolaylaşabilir.
* Erken rehabilitasyon mümkün olabilir.
* Protez ömrü uzayabilir, çıkık riski ve açısal hatalar azalabilir.
* Revizyon ihtimali düşebilir.
* Ameliyat sonrası doğal eklem hissi sağlanabilir.

[Vidasız Dar Kanal]

**Vidasız dar kanal ameliyatı, omurga kanalında meydana gelen daralma nedeniyle sinirlerin sıkışması
ve buna bağlı oluşan ağrı, uyuşma, güç kaybı gibi şikayetlerin giderilmesi için uygulanan bir
cerrahi yöntemdir. **Bu ameliyat, özellikle omurga kanalı daralmasının ileri aşamalarında, sinir
dokularının baskıdan kurtarılması için yapılır ve omurganın stabilitesini artırıcı vida sistemleri
kullanılmadan gerçekleştirilir. Genellikle minimal invaziv tekniklerle uygulanır ve hastanın
iyileşme süresini kısaltmayı hedefler.

### Vidasız Dar Kanal Ameliyatı Neden Tercih Edilir?

Bu ameliyat, özellikle omurganın stabilitesinin tamamen korunabildiği ve vida gibi sabitleyici
materyallere gerek duyulmadığı durumlarda tercih edilir. Bunun birkaç sebebi vardır:
* Omurganın Doğal Yapısının Korunması: Vida ve plaklar kullanılmadığı için omurganın doğal hareket
  kabiliyeti korunur.
* Minimal İnvaziv Teknikler: Daha küçük kesilerle yapılan bu ameliyatlarda kan kaybı, enfeksiyon
  riski ve iyileşme süresi azalır.
* Hasta Konforu: Vida gibi yabancı cisimlerin kullanılmaması hastanın ameliyat sonrası sürecini daha
  konforlu hale getirir.

[MR]

**Çorlu Vatan Hastanesi’nde Yapay Zeka Destekli Yeni MR Cihazımız ile Hizmetinizdeyiz! Daha net
görüntüler ile tanıda ileri teknoloji artık sizin hastanenizde.**
* Multiparametrik Prostat MR
* Temporomandibular Eklem MR
* Tüm Vücut MR
* Kardiak MR

**Tüm Vücut MR**, tek seansta tüm organ ve sistemleri görüntüleyebilen, erken tanıda büyük avantaj
sağlayan en gelişmiş tarama yöntemlerinden biridir. Beyin ve sinir sistemi, boyun, tiroid, akciğer,
karaciğer, safra yolları, pankreas, böbrek, dalak, mide ve bağırsaklar, kadınlarda rahim ve
yumurtalıklar, erkeklerde prostat ve mesane, omurga ve eklemler, kemik iliği ile lenf nodları
incelenir. Radyasyonsuz ve ağrısız olan bu yöntem, hem sağlıklı bireylerde check-up amaçlı hem de
hastalıkların erken evrede yakalanmasında kritik rol oynar.

## SCF FAQ's

Do you hire shipping containers?

Yes, SCF hires containers to a wide range of customers. From large enterprise, to SMEs, councils,
schools, government departments and individuals. Anyone who requires a storage or transport solution
can hire a container from SCF.

Do you sell shipping containers?

Yes, SCF sells containers to a wide range of customers. From large enterprise, to SMEs, councils,
schools, government departments and individuals. Anyone who requires a storage or transport solution
can buy a container from SCF.

Are you a shipping company?

No, SCF does not handle shipping or sea transport logistics. We design and build containers that are
delivered into the Australian market with specific features and product technology that is required
by the many industries we service. 

Do you deliver containers?

SCF works closely with a range of preferred transport suppliers to deliver containers from our
depots to your door.

We do not organise the transport of your container from your address to a second address, however we
can recommend suppliers who do this regularly. 

Do you modify containers?

Our experienced and highly skilled depot teams can modify containers in one of our depots across the
country, which are then delivered to you. 

Our teams do not complete any modifications outside of our fully equipped depots.

## SCF FAQ's

Do you hire shipping containers?

Yes, SCF hires containers to a wide range of customers. From large enterprise, to SMEs, councils,
schools, government departments and individuals. Anyone who requires a storage or transport solution
can hire a container from SCF.

Do you sell shipping containers?

Yes, SCF sells containers to a wide range of customers. From large enterprise, to SMEs, councils,
schools, government departments and individuals. Anyone who requires a storage or transport solution
can buy a container from SCF.

Are you a shipping company?

No, SCF does not handle shipping or sea transport logistics. We design and build containers that are
delivered into the Australian market with specific features and product technology that is required
by the many industries we service. 

Do you deliver containers?

SCF works closely with a range of preferred transport suppliers to deliver containers from our
depots to your door.

We do not organise the transport of your container from your address to a second address, however we
can recommend suppliers who do this regularly. 

Do you modify containers?

Our experienced and highly skilled depot teams can modify containers in one of our depots across the
country, which are then delivered to you. 

Our teams do not complete any modifications outside of our fully equipped depots.

## Our Custom Healthcare Software Development Services

From patient management systems and ERP solutions to specialized medical apps, our custom software
development for healthcare yields HIPAA and GDPR compliant software for quality care.

### [Healthcare App Development ][149]

Our healthcare app development services offer a versatile suite of digital tools & patient
engagement solutions, including [telehealth apps][150], remote monitoring, & [wearable apps,][151]
to simplify patient-provider communication for better daily health management.

### [Epic Integration Services ][152]

Our [Epic integration services][153] help achieve seamless [EMR/EHR integration][154] using [HL7 and
FHIR][155] standards, making it easy for interoperable software to share records and help medical
departments coordinate care more effectively.

### [AI Diagnostics & Medical Imaging ][156]

Our custom healthcare software development company delivers [AI solutions][157] that augment human
capabilities without replacing them, expanding care access, enabling early detection through medical
imaging, & personalizing care through NLP/ML.

### [Healthcare ERP Solutions ][158]

Our healthcare software development services cover a wide range of ERP needs, including [Healthcare
ERP solutions][159], Pharmaceutical ERP, Pharma Biotech ERP, and Medical Device ERP, each designed
to optimize processes and improve compliance.

### [Biotech Software Development ][160]

Through custom healthcare software development service expertise, we create HIPAA and 21 CFR Part
11-compliant [biotech solutions][161] like LIMS, ELNs, and AI research tools that unify data, ensure
compliance, and accelerate discoveries.

### [Medical Billing & Claims ][162]

Our custom operations management software helps healthcare teams run more efficiently and use
resources better. [Medical billing solutions][163] let patients communicate securely with providers,
pay bills through RCM software, and reduce administrative tasks.

Hospitals

## care.

## Centralized scheduling and monitoring systems designed to improve multi-specialty practice
## efficiency.

## Telemedicine apps, e-prescriptions, and billing solutions built for independent practices.

Senior Care Services

## Remote health monitoring and personalized care tools that increase safety and quality of life.

Mental Health & Rehabilitation Centers

## Digital intake, therapy management, and reporting systems for better outcomes.

Clinics

## Scalable platforms for patient registration, diagnostics, and ongoing care coordination.

### Healthcare Companies

Reproductive Genetics

## Secure AI platforms for genomic data management and compliant patient matching.

Health & Wellness

## Mobile apps for fitness, nutrition, and preventive care engagement.

Performance & Sports

## Wearable and motion tracking integrations to monitor performance and recovery.

Medical Device Manufacturers

## IoT-enabled device software with built-in compliance and remote monitoring.

Pharmaceuticals

## ERP and compliance platforms supporting R&D, clinical trials, and supply chain visibility.

Air Medical Transport

## Real-time dispatch, routing, and patient data-sharing applications for emergency care.

## Our Custom Healthcare Software Development Services

From patient management systems and ERP solutions to specialized medical apps, our custom software
development for healthcare yields HIPAA and GDPR compliant software for quality care.

### [Healthcare App Development ][149]

Our healthcare app development services offer a versatile suite of digital tools & patient
engagement solutions, including [telehealth apps][150], remote monitoring, & [wearable apps,][151]
to simplify patient-provider communication for better daily health management.

### [Epic Integration Services ][152]

Our [Epic integration services][153] help achieve seamless [EMR/EHR integration][154] using [HL7 and
FHIR][155] standards, making it easy for interoperable software to share records and help medical
departments coordinate care more effectively.

### [AI Diagnostics & Medical Imaging ][156]

Our custom healthcare software development company delivers [AI solutions][157] that augment human
capabilities without replacing them, expanding care access, enabling early detection through medical
imaging, & personalizing care through NLP/ML.

### [Healthcare ERP Solutions ][158]

Our healthcare software development services cover a wide range of ERP needs, including [Healthcare
ERP solutions][159], Pharmaceutical ERP, Pharma Biotech ERP, and Medical Device ERP, each designed
to optimize processes and improve compliance.

### [Biotech Software Development ][160]

Through custom healthcare software development service expertise, we create HIPAA and 21 CFR Part
11-compliant [biotech solutions][161] like LIMS, ELNs, and AI research tools that unify data, ensure
compliance, and accelerate discoveries.

### [Medical Billing & Claims ][162]

Our custom operations management software helps healthcare teams run more efficiently and use
resources better. [Medical billing solutions][163] let patients communicate securely with providers,
pay bills through RCM software, and reduce administrative tasks.

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative

Adaptive radiotherapy is changing what’s possible in cancer treatment.

Elekta is making it work in routine clinical practice, combining precision, workflow and evidence to
help centers deliver adaptive care as a new standard.

[Adaptive Radiotherapy][225]

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

# Elle Brough

Hi, I'm Elle Brough, a Mechanical/Biomedical Engineer interested in medical device research and
development. I hold a B.S. in Mechanical Engineering with an additional major in Biomedical
Engineering from Carnegie Mellon University (CMU).

I have experience working with implantable glaucoma devices and nitinol, developing testing set-ups
for stroke and spinal cord research, teaching and grading core mechanical engineering courses, and
training students on manufacturing processes.

See my course/research projects on the [CMU Projects][44] page, take a look at more informal
projects I've completed on the [For Fun][45] page, or see my work history on the [CV][46] page.

# Confused patients don't start, and don't stay on treatment.

Therapies are longer, costlier and more complex than ever, and patients face them alone. They drown
in **ChatGPT printouts**, get fed **misinformation on social**, and the one person they trust, their
doctor, has seven minutes and no time to explain. Overwhelmed and confused, they delay, hesitate and
quietly drop off.

[Book a demo →][19] [See what it's costing you][20]
HIPAA‑aligned
MLR‑ready
Built for every care journey
Too much. Too confusing.
The problem, by who it hits

## When patients don't start, everyone loses.

Patient confusion isn't only a patient problem. It quietly erodes revenue and outcomes across every
part of healthcare.

[

### Patients don't sign up for the treatments you recommend.

Treatment hesitation
Patients decline what they don't understand
Anxiety calls
Front-desk time lost to avoidable questions
No-shows and cancellations
Last-minute doubt with no follow-up touchpoint
Comparison shopping
Confusion sends patients price-shopping
Independent Doctors
][21] [

### High abandonment and low adherence erode your gross‑to‑net.

Slow brand starts
28-45 days average to first dose
Abandonment
40-50% of scripts never filled
Early discontinuation
60% of patients stop within 6 months
Gross-to-net pressure
Keeping every single patient on treatment is vital for improving margins.
Pharma & MedTech
][22] [

### Confused patients come back, and readmissions cost you.

Preventable readmissions
Driven by post-discharge confusion
Low HCAHPS scores
Poor discharge communication clarity
Procedure cancellations
Pre-operative anxiety without education
Medication non-adherence
Chronic-disease patients stop therapy
Health Systems
][23]
What we realized

## Patients decide in the kitchen, not the clinic.

Working in hundreds of clinics nationwide, we discovered something simple: patients are nudged
forward into the right treatment by **the voice of their own doctor**, delivered as a short video,
in a text message they can watch at the kitchen table, alongside their spouse.

SMS + RCS Technology

### Meet patients where they already are.

**87% of consumers ignore phone calls from unknown numbers.** But text messages? A 98% open rate
within 3 minutes.

Hoot uses SMS and RCS (Rich Communication Services) to deliver branded, interactive,
compliance‑reviewed content straight to a patient’s native messaging app. No downloads. No logins.
No friction.

**RCS brings app‑like experiences to texting:** verified sender badges, rich media carousels,
interactive buttons and video playback, all inside the patient’s default inbox.

All content MLR‑approvedMeasure & monitor in real time
[Patient and family at kitchen table]
PATIENT & FAMILY · KITCHEN TABLE
The Solution · Meet Hoot

## The doctor they trust, at scale.

Patients believe their own physician, not a brand, not a call center. Hoot turns that trusted doctor
into MLR-approved video sequences and delivers them in the messaging thread patients already open,
so they watch on their own time instead of dodging another 1-800 call.

+

Step 01
Record once
We record a video of the Physician over Zoom once. We handle everything else.
◇ AI CLONE
Step 02

We build a video clone that matches the Doctor’s voice, face and delivery. Or we create clips from
the original online recording.
MLR-APPROVED
Step 03
Medical Legal Regulatory (MLR)-approved videos
We design a series of short videos of the Doctor explaining the condition and the treatment journey.
Dr. Patel
Hi Maya, watch this before your visit.
Your treatment plan
Watch now
Got it, thanks!
DELIVERED
Step 04
Delivered via SMS / RCS
Videos land in the patient’s text thread, ready to watch and share with family.
Sample Patient Journey

forward into the right treatment by **the voice of their own doctor**, delivered as a short video,
in a text message they can watch at the kitchen table, alongside their spouse.

within 3 minutes.

Hoot uses SMS and RCS (Rich Communication Services) to deliver branded, interactive,
compliance‑reviewed content straight to a patient’s native messaging app. No downloads. No logins.
No friction.

**RCS brings app‑like experiences to texting:** verified sender badges, rich media carousels,
interactive buttons and video playback, all inside the patient’s default inbox.

##### Intraoperative MRI

# Precision, Safety & Confidence in Neurosurgery

IMRIS custom designs innovative intraoperative MRI systems specifically for imaging during
neurosurgical procedures. 

[ Learn More ][55]

##### Revolutionizing

# The Operating Room

IMRIS provides the only iMRI System in the world that travels on a ceiling-mounted rail system
between a diagnostic room and adjacent operating rooms, bringing the MRI directly to the patient. 

[ Learn More ][56]

##### Comprehensive

# Services

#### [ Design ][57]

Customized operating suite designs integrate imaging modalities into surgical environments

#### [ Products ][58]

Products designed for use during intraoperative imaging, and supplied in cooperation with industry

### My vision has become cloudy over time. I want to learn more about Cataracts.

[A Black man and woman looking up and smiling]
][12]


[Learn More][13]

## Learn more about some common conditions that may occur

Scroll to learn more about the conditions

[Smiling lady leaning against building]

## Presbyopia

Presbyopia is a decreased ability to see nearby objects, especially in low light. Everyone will
become presbyopic, usually starting around the age of 40; however, laser vision correction offers a
treatment option for this condition.

[Cheerful bearded Black man smiling outside]

## Astigmatism

Astigmatism is a variation in the curvature of the cornea or in the shape of the eye's lens.
Astigmatism results in blurred or distorted vision at all distances. [Laser vision correction][14]
can address astigmatism.

[Older woman looking at the sea during sunrise]

## Dry Eye

Dry Eye is a condition in which a person does not have enough quality tears to lubricate and nourish
the eye. Dry Eye is a common problem, particularly in older adults. Treatment for dry eye symptoms
can help before [cataract][15] or [laser vision correction][16] procedures.

[Older gray haired black man sitting by a window in front of a bookshelf]

## Cataracts

## Pioneering Physiotherapy and Medical Aesthetic Innovations

Unleashing Advanced Technology in Physiotherapy & Medical Aesthetics

[
More Products
][116]

Longest medical works to provide high-quality, cost-effective, and durable physiotherapy equipment,
aesthetic equipment, and rehabilitation devices that are extensively used in sports physiotherapy,
neurological rehabilitation, orthopedics, post-surgical recovery, musculoskeletal physiotherapy,
pain management, and aesthetic medicine.

[28th Madrid World Congress ISMST]
[FDA Approves Longest LGT-2320 Low-Frequency NMES/TENS Devices]
[Longest Medical KEY-products 2026]
[Precision Cold,Optimal Pain Relief]
[Advanced ESWT Device,Enhanced Musculoskeletal Health]
[3 in 1 Combo,Expanded Treatment Capability]
[professional shockwave therapy machine LGT-2500X (1)]
Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet

PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet is a compressed pneumatic ballistic shockwave therapy device, bringing
the most advanced way to treat musculoskeletal disorders in animals with quality, speed, and ease.
With premium features and a sleek design, it is a premier solution for veterinary clinics to
streamline workflow, increase efficiency, and improve animal care.

[Veterinary Extracorporeal Shockwave Therapy Device PowerShocker LGT-2500X Vet][117]
[The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP

The LGT-2660 Series Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Pain is an advanced
rehabilitation device engineered to address a wide range of musculoskeletal pain conditions and
associated dysfunctions. Operating on the principle of electromagnetic induction, it generates
induced currents to regulate neuromuscular function while delivering deeply penetrating energy—this
energy transcends superficial tissues to act directly on muscles, joints, and bones. For both acute
and chronic musculoskeletal pain, it provides a safe, efficient, and medication-free new solution.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP][118]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP

The LGT-2650BP is a premium unisex body contouring device. Powered by high-intensity magnetic
stimulation, it induces intense muscle contractions—effectively boosting muscle tone while reducing
stubborn fat deposits. It is widely suited for weight management, body shaping, and individuals with
excess weight alike.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP][119]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator LGT-2640AP for Pelvic floor rehabilitation]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP

The LGT-2640AP Pelvic Floor Magnetic Stimulator is a precision rehabilitation device designed for
targeted pelvic floor therapy. Featuring 24 visualized preset protocols (paired with anatomical
diagrams), customizable treatment plans, and a pre-adaptation function, it delivers non-invasive,
painless stimulation to support postpartum recovery, male pelvic floor rehabilitation, and geriatric
pelvic health. 

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP][120]
[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP]
High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）

LGT-3500GP fits tight spaces without sacrificing performance. Equipped with full TECAR tech, dual
tissue-targeting modes, and core safety features, it handles post-op rehab, shallow tissue care, and
more—lightweight, durable, and perfect for space-conscious facilities.

[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）][121]
[High Frequency Therapy 3500LP]
High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)

 The LGT-3500LP has an upright design with plenty of storage and rolling casters for easy mobility.
It uses TECAR Therapy, and it has dual CET/RET modes, 300 KHz~1 MHz frequencies, and safety features
like real-time temperature monitoring. This gives you precise, efficient treatments for deep tissue
repair and pain relief.

[High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)][122]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100d 2]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II

The RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II is a rehabilitative training device designed to facilitate both
active and passive movements of a person's lower and upper limbs. This device features four training
modes: active-passive training, assistive training, symmetry training, and isokinetic training.
Additionally, it is equipped with multiple protection functions, including spasm control, emergency
stop, max. speed control, and speed setting prompt.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config
II][123]
[rehab-bike-for-upper-and-lower-limbs-rehamoto-lgt-5100D]
Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D

RehaMoto controls the servo motor through the central processing unit and the biomechanical
monitoring feedback system. Users can do passive, assisted, active, and constant-speed training by
RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config I. The intelligent identification device realizes real - time monitoring
of user training status and smooth conversion between different modes. Fully realize the best
clinical training effect, and promote the recovery of users' motor function.

[Rehab Bike for Upper and Lower Limbs, Active-Passive Trainer (APT) RehaMoto LGT-5100D][124]
[Air Compression Therapy Device]
IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS

The LGT-2210DS is a cutting-edge IPC pump and air compression therapy device, designed to elevate
service standards in physiotherapy, rehabilitation, and cosmetology clinics. It delivers seamless,
comfortable gradient and sequential pneumatic compressions to effectively enhance blood and lymph
flow. Supporting 4-chamber/6-chamber leg/arm cuffs and 24-chamber full-body cuffs, it offers
versatile, precise treatment for diverse needs.

[IPC Pump Lymphatic Drainage Massage Device LGT-2210DS][125]
[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV]
Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV

The LGT-2900EUV Ultrasound Electrotherapy Machine is a remarkable all-in-one device that integrates
ultrasound, electrotherapy, and vacuum therapy. With its modular design, it offers up to three
different modules in a single compact unit, enabling independent or combined treatments of multiple
modalities in one device. This design not only improves efficiency and reduces costs but also
enhances the effects of pain relief, tissue repair, and muscle function recovery through synergistic
effects.

[Combination Therapy Machine Ultrasound and Electrotherapy Device LGT-2900EUV][126]
[lgt-2200dvt]
Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT

The LGT-2200DVT is a compression therapy device comprised of an intermittent pneumatic controller
(main unit), sleeves, and a connection hose. Its working principle is that air inflates and deflates
the sleeves sequentially to generate circulating pressure on the human body. By squeezing the
proximal and distal limbs, it can directly or indirectly promote blood circulation and the lymphatic
system, improve body micro-circulation, prevent thrombi, and reduce limb swelling. It addresses
diseases related to blood and lymph circulation. It is widely used in hospital settings to improve
workflow efficiency and enhance patient care. 

[Effective Gradient Compression DVT Pump LGT-2200DVT][127]
[LGT-2201DVT]
Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Compression Therapy Device LGT-2201DVT

The LGT-2201DVT is a compression therapy device. It is composed of an intermittent pneumatic
controller (main unit), sleeves, and a connection hose. The working principle is that air inflates
and deflates the sleeves sequentially to generate circulating pressure on the human body.

By squeezing the proximal and distal limbs, it can directly or indirectly promote blood circulation
and the lymphatic system, improve the body's micro-circulation, prevent thrombi, reduce limb
swelling, and address diseases related to blood and lymph circulation. Suitable places for use are
clinics and hospitals. 

[Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Compression Therapy Device LGT-2201DVT][128]
[Compression Therapy Device LGT-2202DVT]
LGT - 2202DVT DVT Pump for Hospitals

The LGT-2202DVT is a gradient-pressure compression therapy system engineered to lower the risk of

energy transcends superficial tissues to act directly on muscles, joints, and bones. For both acute
and chronic musculoskeletal pain, it provides a safe, efficient, and medication-free new solution.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Musculoskeletal Rehabilitation LGT-2660AP/BP][118]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP

The LGT-2650BP is a premium unisex body contouring device. Powered by high-intensity magnetic
stimulation, it induces intense muscle contractions—effectively boosting muscle tone while reducing
stubborn fat deposits. It is widely suited for weight management, body shaping, and individuals with
excess weight alike.

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Body Shaping LGT-2650BP][119]
[Electromagnetic Stimulator LGT-2640AP for Pelvic floor rehabilitation]
Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP

The LGT-2640AP Pelvic Floor Magnetic Stimulator is a precision rehabilitation device designed for
targeted pelvic floor therapy. Featuring 24 visualized preset protocols (paired with anatomical
diagrams), customizable treatment plans, and a pre-adaptation function, it delivers non-invasive,
painless stimulation to support postpartum recovery, male pelvic floor rehabilitation, and geriatric
pelvic health. 

[Electromagnetic Stimulator for Pelvic floor rehabilitation LGT-2640AP][120]
[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP]
High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）

LGT-3500GP fits tight spaces without sacrificing performance. Equipped with full TECAR tech, dual
tissue-targeting modes, and core safety features, it handles post-op rehab, shallow tissue care, and
more—lightweight, durable, and perfect for space-conscious facilities.

[High-Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500GP（Desktop Design）][121]
[High Frequency Therapy 3500LP]
High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)

 The LGT-3500LP has an upright design with plenty of storage and rolling casters for easy mobility.
It uses TECAR Therapy, and it has dual CET/RET modes, 300 KHz~1 MHz frequencies, and safety features
like real-time temperature monitoring. This gives you precise, efficient treatments for deep tissue
repair and pain relief.

[High Frequency Therapy Device LGT-3500LP(Upright Design)][122]

The RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config II is a rehabilitative training device designed to facilitate both
active and passive movements of a person's lower and upper limbs. This device features four training
modes: active-passive training, assistive training, symmetry training, and isokinetic training.
Additionally, it is equipped with multiple protection functions, including spasm control, emergency
stop, max. speed control, and speed setting prompt.

RehaMoto LGT-5100D Config I. The intelligent identification device realizes real - time monitoring
of user training status and smooth conversion between different modes. Fully realize the best
clinical training effect, and promote the recovery of users' motor function.

The LGT-2210DS is a cutting-edge IPC pump and air compression therapy device, designed to elevate

comfortable gradient and sequential pneumatic compressions to effectively enhance blood and lymph
flow. Supporting 4-chamber/6-chamber leg/arm cuffs and 24-chamber full-body cuffs, it offers
versatile, precise treatment for diverse needs.

ultrasound, electrotherapy, and vacuum therapy. With its modular design, it offers up to three
different modules in a single compact unit, enabling independent or combined treatments of multiple
modalities in one device. This design not only improves efficiency and reduces costs but also

effects.

The LGT-2200DVT is a compression therapy device comprised of an intermittent pneumatic controller
(main unit), sleeves, and a connection hose. Its working principle is that air inflates and deflates

workflow efficiency and enhance patient care.

# Helhetsleverantör

Vi är helhetsleverantör till sjukhus, kliniker, laboratorier och bårhus i Norden

[Kontakta oss][158]

# Innovativa lösningar

Medicinteknik för vårdens alla miljöer

[Kontakta oss][159]

## Dina behov, Våra lösningar

Meditea hjälper sjukhus att bygga säkra och effektiva vårdmiljöer genom integrerade medicintekniska
lösningar.

 

Vi levererar allt från operationssalsutrustning och medicinska försörjningssystem till
teknikintegration och projektledning med fokus på patientsäkerhet, arbetsflöde och framtida
flexibilitet.

* En enda kontaktpunkt för alla dina medicinska behov

## Helhetslösningar för modern vård. En trygg partner för offentlig och privat sektor

][169]
Meditea är en nordisk helhetsleverantör av medicintekniska lösningar till sjukhus, kliniker och
vårdinrättningar. Med över tio års erfarenhet levererar vi funktionella, säkra och framtidssäkra
vårdmiljöer – från planering till färdig drift.
[

## Avancerad fotodynamisk behandling för estetiska kliniker

][170]
Inom estetisk medicin och modern hudvård spelar tidig upptäckt och rätt behandling en viktig roll
för att uppnå trygga och hållbara resultat. Fotodynamisk behandling (PDT) har blivit ett av de mest
efterfrågade alternativen vid behandling av aktinisk keratos (AK) – ett förstadium till hudcancer
som oftast orsakas av långvarig solexponering. Vad är fotodynamisk behandling (PDT)? Vid PDT används
ett ljuskänsligt preparat, vanligtvis 5-ALA eller MAL, tillsammans med en medicinsk
[

## Tillförlitliga formalindistributionssystem för säkra och effektiva laboratoriearbetsflöden

][171]
Moderna laboratorier, patologiavdelningar och medicinska anläggningar kräver i allt högre grad
säker, effektiv och helt kontrollerad formalindistribution. I takt med att riskbedömningar utvecklas
och regleringar skärps söker organisationer system som minimerar hantering, förbättrar noggrannheten
och säkerställer fullständig spårbarhet i formalinförsörjningskedjan. Vi erbjuder skräddarsydda
distributionslösningar för formalin, utformade för att möta behoven hos både traditione

## Dina behov, Våra lösningar

Meditea hjälper sjukhus att bygga säkra och effektiva vårdmiljöer genom integrerade medicintekniska
lösningar.

 

Vi levererar allt från operationssalsutrustning och medicinska försörjningssystem till
teknikintegration och projektledning med fokus på patientsäkerhet, arbetsflöde och framtida
flexibilitet.

## Helhetslösningar för modern vård. En trygg partner för offentlig och privat sektor

][169]
Meditea är en nordisk helhetsleverantör av medicintekniska lösningar till sjukhus, kliniker och
vårdinrättningar. Med över tio års erfarenhet levererar vi funktionella, säkra och framtidssäkra
vårdmiljöer – från planering till färdig drift.
[

## Avancerad fotodynamisk behandling för estetiska kliniker

][170]
Inom estetisk medicin och modern hudvård spelar tidig upptäckt och rätt behandling en viktig roll
för att uppnå trygga och hållbara resultat. Fotodynamisk behandling (PDT) har blivit ett av de mest
efterfrågade alternativen vid behandling av aktinisk keratos (AK) – ett förstadium till hudcancer
som oftast orsakas av långvarig solexponering. Vad är fotodynamisk behandling (PDT)? Vid PDT används
ett ljuskänsligt preparat, vanligtvis 5-ALA eller MAL, tillsammans med en medicinsk
[

## Tillförlitliga formalindistributionssystem för säkra och effektiva laboratoriearbetsflöden

][171]
Moderna laboratorier, patologiavdelningar och medicinska anläggningar kräver i allt högre grad
säker, effektiv och helt kontrollerad formalindistribution. I takt med att riskbedömningar utvecklas
och regleringar skärps söker organisationer system som minimerar hantering, förbättrar noggrannheten
och säkerställer fullständig spårbarhet i formalinförsörjningskedjan. Vi erbjuder skräddarsydda
distributionslösningar för formalin, utformade för att möta behoven hos både traditione

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

prosperous, and democratic Ukraine. We achieve this by creating, inspiring, and collaborating on
initiatives that motivate people to think, partner and do.

Razom, which means “together” in Ukrainian, is dedicated to upholding the principles of the
Revolution of Dignity (Maidan) and actively contributing to the establishment of a secure,
prosperous, and democratic Ukraine. We achieve this by creating, inspiring, and collaborating on
initiatives that motivate people to think, partner and do.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

## Robot Applications

documentation.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]

Leading Emergency Response

We empower responders at every skill level with world-class trauma medicine products—when they need
them most
[Our Mission][65]

### OUR PRODUCTS

From high-performance medical bag essentials to hyper-realistic simulation equipment, our products
are trusted by medical professionals to preserve life.

Hemorrhage Control

Devices used to rapidly and effectively control traumatic bleeding in pre-hospital treatment.

Airway Management

Solutions for maintaining patient airways, organized to prioritize the least invasive maneuver for
each situation.

Respiration

Products that focus on correcting, managing, and monitoring injuries that affect a patient’s ability
to breath effectively.

Circulation & Bandages

Devices designed to rapidly gain access to the circulatory system to support resuscitation, manage
hemorrhage shock, and more.

Burn Management

Products that remove heat and instantly cool burns to minimize skin and tissue damage. A crucial
step in the Rampart™ System.

Head & Hypothermia

Warming technology to help maintain proper body temperature in trauma and non-trauma situations.

Moulage & Kits

Our range of moulage accessories is designed to simulate blood and open wounds.

Leading Emergency Response

We empower responders at every skill level with world-class trauma medicine products—when they need
them most
[Our Mission][65]

### OUR PRODUCTS

From high-performance medical bag essentials to hyper-realistic simulation equipment, our products
are trusted by medical professionals to preserve life.

Hemorrhage Control

Devices used to rapidly and effectively control traumatic bleeding in pre-hospital treatment.

Airway Management

Solutions for maintaining patient airways, organized to prioritize the least invasive maneuver for
each situation.

Respiration

Products that focus on correcting, managing, and monitoring injuries that affect a patient’s ability
to breath effectively.

Circulation & Bandages

Devices designed to rapidly gain access to the circulatory system to support resuscitation, manage
hemorrhage shock, and more.

Burn Management

Products that remove heat and instantly cool burns to minimize skin and tissue damage. A crucial
step in the Rampart™ System.

Head & Hypothermia

Warming technology to help maintain proper body temperature in trauma and non-trauma situations.

Markets are changing faster than most planning cycles. Technology, regulation, supply chain shocks
and shifting customer expectations are rewriting the rules across every sector.

Strategic Revenue Insights gives leaders a clear view of where demand is heading, how value pools
are shifting and which bets matter most. We combine rigorous research with practical advisory so
your next move is grounded in evidence, not instinct.

## Our Strategic Process

We connect market signals to revenue decisions through a simple, repeatable flow.

### Market Signals

Track macro trends, policy shifts, technology disruption and competitive moves.

### Strategic Insights

Convert data into clear narratives on risk, growth pockets and profit pools.

### Actionable Strategies

## Market Sizing and Forecasting

Strategic Revenue Insights delivers precise market sizing and forecasting that cut through
uncertainty and reveal measurable opportunity. Using rigorous data, cross-industry expertise, and
scenario-based models, we help organizations understand market potential, anticipate shifts, and
make confident strategic decisions grounded in evidence, clarity, and forward-looking intelligence.

Robust models that quantify market size, growth and segment level outlook over five to ten years. We
stress test scenarios against macro assumptions, regulation and technology adoption.

## Competitive and Benchmarking Analysis

Our Competitive & Benchmarking Analysis gives leaders a clear, evidence-backed understanding of
where they stand in the market, how competitors are shifting their strategies, and which
capabilities drive advantage. We decode competitor moves, benchmark performance across multiple
lenses, and deliver actionable guidance that strengthens positioning and informs confident,
forward-looking decisions.

Clear views of how incumbents and disruptors are positioned. We map portfolios, pricing, innovation
focus, channel strategies and financial performance to show where you stand and where gaps exist.
